hikes.name: Mirror Lake and Tom Dick and Harry Mountain
hikes.blurb: A gentle climb to a lake that holds Mt Hood's reflection, then up the ridge behind it for the full view.

hikes.name: Ramona Falls Loop
hikes.blurb: Across the Sandy River to a broad, lacy falls spilling over columnar basalt, back along a mossy creek.

hikes.name: McNeil Point
hikes.blurb: Up the Timberline Trail through wildflower meadows to an old stone shelter right under the mountain's north face.

hikes.name: Zigzag Canyon from Timberline Lodge
hikes.blurb: West on the Timberline Trail across open slopes to the rim of a huge glacier-carved canyon.

hikes.name: Paradise Park via Zigzag Canyon
hikes.blurb: Through Zigzag Canyon and up into Paradise Park's high meadows of lupine and heather, to a falls at their far edge.

hikes.name: Silcox Hut
hikes.blurb: A short, steep walk above Timberline to a 1930s stone warming hut with the Cascades lined up to the south.

hikes.name: Elk Meadows
hikes.blurb: Across Clark and Newton Creeks to a big meadow ringed by trees with Mt Hood rising straight behind it.

hikes.name: Gnarl Ridge and Lamberson Butte
hikes.blurb: Past Elk Meadows to a windswept ridge on the edge of Newton Creek's canyon, looking into the Newton Clark Glacier.

hikes.name: Cooper Spur
hikes.blurb: The highest trail on the mountain: a rocky spur above the Eliot Glacier's crevasses, reaching nearly 8,500 feet.

hikes.name: Tamanawas Falls
hikes.blurb: Up Cold Spring Creek to a 100-foot curtain of water falling over a wide basalt overhang.

hikes.name: Burnt Lake
hikes.blurb: Through old forest to a quiet lake that mirrors Mt Hood's west face.

hikes.name: Vista Ridge, Cairn Basin and Eden Park
hikes.blurb: Up a burned ridge carpeted with avalanche lilies and beargrass to the north side's stream-laced meadows.

hikes.name: Elk Cove
hikes.blurb: Along the north side's meadows to a hidden bowl of flowers under the Coe Glacier.

hikes.name: Twin Lakes
hikes.blurb: Up the Pacific Crest Trail to two forested lakes, the upper one with a viewpoint over the Barlow area.

hikes.name: Umbrella Falls
hikes.blurb: A short walk to a 60-foot fan of water on the East Fork Hood River, wildflowers along the way.

hikes.name: Lookout Mountain
hikes.blurb: An easy summit on Mt Hood's east side with a view from Rainier to Jefferson and down into Badger Creek.

hikes.name: Hunchback Mountain
hikes.blurb: A steep climb from Zigzag to a long, rocky ridge with lookouts over the Salmon River and Mt Hood.

hikes.name: Little Zigzag Falls
hikes.blurb: A few easy minutes along a clear creek to a slender cascade, a good stop on the way up the pass.

hikes.name: Salmon Butte
hikes.blurb: Rhododendron forest to an old lookout site with Hood, Jefferson and the Salmon-Huckleberry Wilderness below.

hikes.name: Timothy Lake Loop
hikes.blurb: All the way around a big mountain lake on flat, forested trail, past Little Crater Lake's impossibly clear spring.

hikes.name: Barrett Spur
hikes.blurb: A long day up through the north side's meadows and onto a high spur between the Coe and Ladd Glaciers.

hikes.name: Yocum Ridge
hikes.blurb: A big day past Ramona Falls and up a narrow ridge to point-blank views of the Sandy and Reid Glaciers.

hikes.name: Veda Lake
hikes.blurb: Over a little ridge with a view of Hood to a small lake tucked in a bowl south of the pass.

hikes.name: Bald Mountain and Muddy Fork
hikes.blurb: A short climb to the Timberline Trail's open slope on Bald Mountain, looking straight across at Mt Hood.

hikes.name: Gumjuwac Saddle and Badger Lake
hikes.blurb: A steep climb out of the East Fork valley to a saddle and a remote lake on the mountain's dry side.

hikes.name: Boulder Ridge from Wildwood
hikes.blurb: A long climb from the Salmon River confluence through big trees to a ridge of huckleberries and views.

hikes.name: Palmer Glacier
hikes.blurb: From Salmon River Parking, a 4.0-mile round trip to the edge of Palmer Glacier, with about 2,350 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Lolo Pass
hikes.blurb: From Top Spur Trailhead, a 6.3-mile round trip to Lolo Pass, with about 1,750 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Abbot Pass
hikes.blurb: From Joe Graham / Pacific Crest Trailhead, a 10.2-mile round trip to Abbot Pass, with about 900 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Barlow Pass
hikes.blurb: From Devils Half Acre Trailhead, a 1.8-mile round trip to Barlow Pass, with about 400 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Cooper Spur Falls
hikes.blurb: From Cloud Cap Trailhead, a 5.5-mile round trip to Cooper Spur Falls, with about 2,400 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mount Mitchell
hikes.blurb: From Frazier Turnaround Trailhead, a 9.1-mile round trip to the top of Mount Mitchell (4,963 ft), with about 1,800 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Coe Falls
hikes.blurb: From Cloud Cap Trailhead, an 8.9-mile round trip to Coe Falls, with about 2,150 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Eden Park Falls
hikes.blurb: From Mazama Trailhead, a 6.3-mile round trip to Eden Park Falls, with about 2,150 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Kinzel Lake
hikes.blurb: From Cool Creek Trailhead, a 9.7-mile round trip to Kinzel Lake, with about 4,300 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Zigzag Mountain
hikes.blurb: From West Zigzag / Cast Lake Trailhead, a 6.8-mile round trip to the top of Zigzag Mountain (4,829 ft), with about 1,650 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Newton Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: From Cloud Cap Trailhead, a 6.2-mile round trip to Newton Creek Falls, with about 1,950 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Clark Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: From Main Parking Lot, a 4.7-mile round trip to Clark Creek Falls, with about 1,050 feet of climbing.
